prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset for Turnip Works, heroic hand-painted miniature game art. One free-standing architectural PILLAR (a column that holds up a ceiling), not a statue: a square stepped plinth base, one thick shaft, and a broad square capital with a completely FLAT TOP. Proportions 30 inches across and 120 inches tall: a tall column about four times as tall as it is wide. A peaceful RAVEN with folded wings perches on top of the capital; the shaft carries a large HOURGLASS in relief and a thick carved shroud draped from the capital. The motif belongs to the column itself and reads from every side and from above. Palette: warm ivory and ink black. Stout connected forms, broad bevels, clear part separation, matte painted gradients, restrained surface texture, no glossy PBR. Exactly one complete object centered with generous clear margin, no scene or additional objects, no text, no logos, no specific published mythology or recognizable product design. Three-quarter view from ABOVE, camera elevation 35 degrees, so the flat top of the capital and the whole shaft down to the base are visible; the whole column fits in the frame. Genuinely transparent background, no floor or cast shadow. Thick reconstructible parts; no wires, chains, delicate horns, thin spikes or isolated floating components.
